results.content:
It’s a mixed bag for consumers as the streaming calendar shifts to fall, with the return of some fan-favorite series but also another round of price hikes.

Apple AAPL just raised its price by $2 a month, its fourth increase in the past four years. Comcast’s CMCSA Peacock did the same earlier in August, after Netflix NFLX, Amazon AMZN and Paramount+ PSKY announced hikes earlier this year. Don’t be surprised if Warner Bros. Discovery’s WBD HBO Max and Disney DIS follow by year’s end.
